contract: design/quick-specs/first-chapter-2026-11-03.md: actual map first; read-only five-stage progress and normal confirmation screens; 44px controls; no overflow; keyboard focus; 390x844, 440x956, 1280x900

accessibility.evidence: Actual Tab and Shift+Tab navigation focuses the primary button with a solid outline; Enter opens the real gift dialog. All six new strip buttons measure at least 44px high; stages have names and current-step semantics; no animation is added.

responsive.evidence: All three real viewports have document scrollWidth at or below viewport width and all strip controls at least 44px high; screenshots visually inspected. Five-stage strip uses one row on phone and splits beside the heading on desktop.

loading.reason: The new strip synchronously projects the already loaded local engine; it has no fetch or asynchronous loading step.

empty.reason: The strip has five fixed chapter stages. After the legitimate completion reward is claimed, it is intentionally removed; no empty list is rendered.

error.reason: The new strip only reads state and opens existing navigation/confirmation dialogs. It introduces no data loader or write/error transaction; existing engine validation is covered separately.

partial.evidence: New game shows zero completed stages, unknown garrison and disabled unavailable stage buttons. First-victory checkpoint shows Qingzhu as the next stage; clicking it opens its real unknown-intel dialog without changing the saved state.

success.evidence: A legitimately earned five-stage completion save is loaded with its original simulation clock; after its normal reward collection the strip is removed and the continuing game is shown.

permission.reason: No account, sharing, device or storage permission is added by the read-only strip. Mutating actions remain in the existing save-session-controlled confirmation screens.

renderedEvidence.observation: Phone map with opening objective, useful reward text and five 44px stage controls; no horizontal overflow.
Larger phone retains map and target actions under the compact progress strip.
Desktop chapter heading and five-stage row fit beside each other above the map.
Legitimate completed first chapter continues to existing game screens without a stale opening strip.
